On Tue, Sep 14, 2027 at 09:05 AM Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask.

I've reviewed the SIG workbook and sketched the technical artifact list. A few clarifications from the Security/Platform side:

1) Evidence windows: Greenline asked for "last 12 months" — we can provide logs and configuration snapshots for the last 12 months where retained, but retention differs by artifact (audit logs: 365 days for control plane; request logs: 90 days by default unless configured on Dedicated/Private). We'll annotate each evidence item in the workbook with the retention window.

2) KMS / key provenance: we'll include KMS access logs and key rotation records for the platform KMS tenants. For Private deployments we can provide custodian contact and key escrow guidance, but for hosted multitenant customers we provide tenant-level key rotation metadata (not raw key material).

3) Network diagrams: Jonas will finalize diagrams showing subnet-level egress controls and peering with cloud regions (US-East, US-West). For on-prem/VPC customers we will tie diagrams to the specific deployment model.

4) Redaction / sensitive data: we'll provide redacted copies where required; if Greenline needs full logs for audit, we'll offer an approved secure transfer mechanism and legal/DAA terms.

I'll attach a short artifact checklist (referenced as "redwood-network-diagram.pdf" and "SOC2-Artifact-Index.csv") to the Drive. Marissa — can you confirm the SOC 2 assertions we should prioritize for the RFP (typically Availability, Security, Confidentiality)?

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Platform Security, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire and SOC2 evidence request

Good questions — aligning on scope now will save time. For RFPs like Greenline's, prioritize: Security (CC), Availability, Confidentiality, and Processing Integrity. We should include:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) with the management assertion
- Control mappings for SIG-L3/L4 items relevant to cloud service operations
- Evidence for access control (IAM role lists, recent access reviews), change control (SRE runbooks + deploy logs), and incident response (postmortems redacted)

I'll start assembling the control-owner table; I'll tag artifacts in the workbook with an internal owner and confidence (High/Medium/Low). For medium/low items we should propose mitigations and compensating controls to satisfy Greenline's reviewers quickly.

Also, note that Greenline is asking about US-only data residency: Ava, confirm whether the customer's account is set to US-only region; if they plan to use Dedicated or Private, that changes the evidence set (we can certify VPC isolation + region-specific storage).

Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance & Assurance, Redwood Inference
